No role system beyond customer isolation, and no broader authorization redesign.","V":"A customer can sign in, create and access its own records, and a different customer cannot read or mutate those records in tests or manual verification.","X":"Stop if the current auth path cannot support per-customer isolation without introducing a new identity system, or if ownership retrofitting requires a broader data-model migration than this slice.","P":"Persist through the smallest verifiable multi-tenant login slice and pause at the first dependency on a new identity decision.","ready":true},"promotions":[],"stop_after_contract":true},{"task_id":"ambiguous-02-notification-channel","route":"quick","turns":[{"question":null,"scripted_answer_index":null,"draft_ready":true}],"contract":{"G":"Notify users in the product when a build finishes.","T":"Emit an in-app notification from the existing build-completion event.","S":"Only in-product notifications using the existing notification surface. No email, mobile push, or external provider setup.","V":"When a build finishes, the relevant user receives a new in-app notification visible in the existing notifications UI.","X":"Stop if build-finished events do not identify the target user or there is no existing notification write path to reuse.","P":"Persist through the in-app first version only.","ready":true},"promotions":[],"stop_after_contract":true},{"task_id":"ambiguous-03-csv-import-mapping","route":"guided","turns":[{"question":"When a CSV contains invalid rows, should import stop entirely or should users preview the file and choose to skip invalid rows before saving?","scripted_answer_index":0,"draft_ready":true}],"contract":{"G":"Let users import contacts from CSV with validation before any data is saved.","T":"Add a CSV import flow with column mapping, preview, row validation, and confirm-to-import behavior that allows invalid rows to be skipped.","S":"CSV upload, mapping required fields, validation for name plus one reachable address, duplicate-email checks against current rules, preview with per-row errors, and no writes before final confirmation.","V":"A user can upload a CSV, map columns, review valid and invalid rows, choose to skip invalid rows, and after confirmation only valid non-duplicate contacts are saved.","X":"Stop if required contact fields cannot be mapped from the file or if preview-time validation needs broader importer infrastructure than this slice.","P":"Persist through a single interactive import flow and exclude any partial-save behavior before confirmation.","ready":true},"promotions":[],"stop_after_contract":true},{"task_id":"ambiguous-06-offline-mode","route":"guided","turns":[{"question":"For the first version, do people need offline editing, or is offline reading of previously opened documents enough?","scripted_answer_index":0,"draft_ready":true}],"contract":{"G":"Allow previously opened documents to be readable while offline.","T":"Use the existing client read cache to support offline opening of documents that were fetched earlier, without offline edits.","S":"Cached document read path, offline detection and read-only UI state, and clear stale/offline messaging. No mutation queue, sync, or conflict resolution.","V":"After opening a document online, the same document can be reopened while disconnected and is clearly marked read-only/offline; uncached documents remain unavailable.","X":"Stop if cached documents cannot be addressed reliably from the existing client cache or if offline reads unexpectedly require sync or conflict semantics.","P":"Persist through offline read-only support and pause before any edit or synchronization work.","ready":true},"promotions":[],"stop_after_contract":true},{"task_id":"ambiguous-04-team-invitations","route":"guided","turns":[{"question":"Should admins create membership immediately, or must invitees accept an invitation before membership exists?","scripted_answer_index":0,"draft_ready":true}],"contract":{"G":"Add team invitations that use the current membership service but require invitee acceptance.","T":"Introduce a pending invitation flow with expiring acceptance links, creating membership only after invitee acceptance.","S":"Invitation creation, pending invitation state, 7-day expiry, acceptance handling, and final membership creation with existing owner/member roles. No automatic membership on send and no new role types.","V":"An admin can send an invite, the invite stays pending until accepted, expired links fail after 7 days, and accepted invites create membership through the current membership service.","X":"Stop if the membership service cannot be invoked safely after acceptance or if secure pending-invitation token handling is unavailable.","P":"Persist through the acceptance-based invitation slice and stop short of broader organization-management redesign.","ready":true},"promotions":[],"stop_after_contract":true},{"task_id":"ambiguous-05-search-filter","route":"guided","turns":[{"question":"When you say Account, do you mean the sign-in identity account or the billable organization account?","scripted_answer_index":0,"draft_ready":true}],"contract":{"G":"Add a global-search filter for billable organizations.","T":"Add an Account filter that scopes global search results to billing organizations, not sign-in identities.","S":"Filter naming and behavior, query wiring for organization results, and UI/API updates needed to distinguish billable organization accounts from person accounts. No authentication changes.","V":"Selecting the Account filter returns only billable organization matches and excludes person sign-in accounts; terminology is consistent in UI and tests.","X":"Stop if current search indexing cannot distinguish billing organizations from person accounts without a broader schema or search refactor.","P":"Persist through the terminology clarification and minimal search-filter implementation.","ready":true},"promotions":[],"stop_after_contract":true}]}
